events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock reflection
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million gathered for peace, love, and music. What's your ultimate festival memory?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 91
events.blurb: Remembering Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, who passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis tribute
angles.copy: Still the King. On the anniversary of his passing, we celebrate the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley.

events.title: Tupac Shakur would have been 55
events.blurb: Remembering influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away on this day in 1996, at the age of 25, after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac legacy
angles.copy: His words still resonate. A tribute to Tupac Shakur, gone far too soon, but never forgotten.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix would have been 84
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix tribute
angles.copy: Still setting guitars alight. Honoring the unmatched talent of Jimi Hendrix on the anniversary of his passing.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road celebration
angles.copy: That iconic cover, those timeless tracks. Celebrating 57 years of The Beatles' 'Abbey Road'.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer and founder of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde birthday shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the rock icon, Chrissie Hynde! Still going strong with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher birthday wish
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine reflection
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... still a powerful message 55 years on from John Lennon's seminal album.

events.title: First iPod released anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the revolutionary first iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember loading up your first iPod? 25 years since Apple launched the device that put a thousand songs in your pocket.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Bond celebration
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day! What's your favourite Bond film or theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: John Lennon tribute birthday
angles.copy: Imagine... a world celebrating the 86th birthday of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary actor and comedian John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese birthday wish
angles.copy: No silly walks, just big laughs! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album celebration
angles.copy: 58 years of groundbreaking music. The Beatles' 'White Album' still sounds as fresh and diverse as ever.

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury tribute
angles.copy: The show must go on. A tribute to the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
